t: Letter To SMP Re Appoitment Of Zau Zung Fam As Chief Detective In Shanghai Of Chekiang No. 7 Special District

A.S. 500-5-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai First Special District Court.

No. 3031.                                      January    9,    1933.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

    I am in receipt of a letter from the Adminis-
trative Commissioner of the Chekiang No. 7 Special
District to the following effect :-

    "Activities of Chen-hsien (嵊縣) bandits have
been notorious for many years, although actions have
been repeatedly taken against them, yet still we are
unable to eradicate them. The reason is because their
leaders are taking refuge in Shanghai where they can
obtain military supplies such as firearms and other
contrabands. In order to enforce our suppressive
measures, apart from taking direct actions against
them, it is essential to suppress the source of their
arms' supply. Zau Zung Fah (趙順法) has been appointed
as our Chief Detective stationing in Shanghai where he
will conduct confidential enquiries regarding the above
matter. As this is within your jurisdiction, I have to
request you to notify the Police Force to render
assistance to the above named when required."

    In view of the foregoing letter, I shall be
obliged if you will be good enough to circulate the
above for information of all concerned.

                                            Kwoh Yuin Koun
                                                President.

（右上角批注：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C & S. B. REGISTRY / D 4397 / "1/ 43）
（左下角手写批注：Dao; L / Sr. D.r. / [签名] / H/J）
（左下角印章：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / JAMES OS / CRIME BRANCH）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总监办公室。

上海第一特区地方法院来函译文。

第 3031 号。                                      1933 年 1 月 9 日。

致：
上海，
警务处总部。

先生们：

    本人收到浙江第七特区行政专员来信，内容如下：

    “嵊县匪徒之活动多年来臭名昭著，虽屡次采取打击行动，但仍未能将其根除。究其原因，在于其头目藏匿于上海，得以获取枪支及其他违禁品等军用物资。为贯彻我方镇压措施，除直接对其采取行动外，必须切断其武器供应来源。赵顺法（Zau Zung Fah）已被任命为我方驻上海首席侦探，将就上述事项进行秘密调查。鉴于此事属于贵方管辖范围，特此请贵方通知警队，在需要时向上述人员提供协助。”

    鉴于上述来信，如蒙贵方将以上内容通传各相关人员知悉，本人将不胜感激。

                                            郭元坤（Kwoh Yuin Koun）
                                                院长

（右上角批注：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与特别股登记室 / D 4397 / "1/ 43）
（左下角手写批注：Dao; L / 高级侦探长 / [签名] / H/J）
